name: Happy Lunar New Year
description: Year of the Goat begins 2027-02-06. Mail in the last week of January to every client with 2 or more visits. Mandarin speakers get a Simplified Chinese version, Cantonese speakers Traditional Chinese, Korean speakers a Seollal (Korean New Year) greeting in Korean.
occasion: Lunar New Year greeting (Year of the Goat, 2027)
guidelines: Wish them a happy and healthy Lunar New Year, the Year of the Goat, from their stylist and the salon. Warm, traditional good wishes (health, peace, good fortune) are welcome. The second-language version should use natural New Year greetings rather than a literal translation (Chinese: 新春快乐 style wishes; Korean: 설날 and 새해 복 많이 받으세요). No offers, no booking push.
